title: BoulderHouse Langford
specs: Dedicated kids climbing area called the TreeHouse
Weekly reset of climbing problems to keep challenges fresh
Children under 3 not permitted to climb in TreeHouse
Groups must maintain at least one adult per three children
Children 12 and under must climb in TreeHouse unless passing TreeHouse Exam with 1:1 adult supervision
Waiver required for all climbers, signed by legal guardian if under 19
Birthday parties for ages 5-12, $210 for 8 children
Group bookings and field trips available by request
includes: Rental shoes included in party price
Safety orientation by coaches for first timers
gap: Exact drop-in hours for TreeHouse not fully stated
blurb: BoulderHouse Langford offers bouldering climbing on 13-foot walls using coloured holds. The TreeHouse is a dedicated kids climbing area for children 12 and under, with specific programs and a safety orientation. The gym resets climbing problems weekly to keep challenges fresh.
extraNote: Parties must be booked at least two weeks in advance · First visit to TreeHouse is free for rentals, then $3.50 for kids shoe rental · TreeHouse memberships billed to valid credit card, $60 EFT start up fee may apply · BoulderHouse parking lot at Main Stadium Parking Lot, gravel parking lot in front of the gym
